chunks: I was in the presence of Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), and with him was a group of his followers, and the mention of intellect and ignorance came up. So Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'Recognise the intellect and its army, and the ignorance and its army, and you will be rightly guided.' Sama'a said: 'So I said: May I be sacrificed for you! We do not recognise anything except what you have taught us.'

So Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'Indeed, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, created the intellect, and it was the first creation from among the spiritual beings, from the right side of the Throne, from His Light. So He said to it: "Turn away!" So it turned away. Then He said to it: "Come forward!" So it came forward. So Allah, Blessed and Exalted, said: "I have created you as a magnificent creation, and I have honoured you above all of My creation."'

He said: Then He created ignorance from the bitter, dark ocean. So He said to it: "Turn away!" So it turned away. Then He said to it: "Come forward!" But it did not come forward. So He said to it: "You have been arrogant." So He cursed it. Then He made seventy-five armies for the intellect. So when ignorance saw what Allah had honoured the intellect with and what He had granted it, it harboured enmity towards it. So ignorance said: "O Lord! This is a creation like me. You created it and honoured it and strengthened it, and I am its opposite, and I have no power against it. So grant me an army like what You granted it." So He said: "Yes, but if you disobey after this, I shall expel you and your army from My mercy." It said: "I am satisfied." Then He granted it seventy-five armies.

So from what He gave the intellect from among the seventy-five soldiers: Goodness — and it is the minister of the intellect — and He made its opposite evil — and it is the minister of ignorance. Faith and its opposite is disbelief. Affirmation and its opposite is denial. Hope and its opposite is despair. Justice and its opposite is injustice. Contentment and its opposite is displeasure. Gratitude and its opposite is ingratitude. Aspiration and its opposite is hopelessness. Reliance [on God] and its opposite is greed. Compassion and its opposite is cruelty. Mercy and its opposite is anger. Knowledge and its opposite is ignorance. Understanding and its opposite is foolishness. Chastity and its opposite is shamelessness. Asceticism and its opposite is worldly desire. Gentleness and its opposite is crudeness. Awe [of God] and its opposite is audacity. Humility and its opposite is arrogance. Deliberateness and its opposite is hastiness. Forbearance and its opposite is foolish impulsiveness. Silence and its opposite is blathering. Submission and its opposite is haughtiness. Acceptance and its opposite is doubt. Patience and its opposite is anxiety. Forgiveness and its opposite is revenge. Self-sufficiency and its opposite is poverty. Remembrance and its opposite is heedlessness. Memorization and its opposite is forgetfulness. Kindness and its opposite is severing ties. Contentment and its opposite is covetousness. Consolation and its opposite is withholding.

Cordiality and its opposite is enmity. Faithfulness and its opposite is treachery. Obedience and its opposite is disobedience. Humbleness and its opposite is insolence. Well-being and its opposite is affliction. Love and its opposite is hatred. Truthfulness and its opposite is lying. Truth and its opposite is falsehood. Trustworthiness and its opposite is treachery. Sincerity and its opposite is adulteration. Alertness and its opposite is dullness. Comprehension and its opposite is obtuseness. Recognition and its opposite is denial. Diplomacy and its opposite is exposure. Guarding the unseen and its opposite is scheming. Discretion and its opposite is disclosure. Prayer and its opposite is neglect. Fasting and its opposite is breaking the fast. Struggle and its opposite is cowardice. Pilgrimage and its opposite is breaking the covenant. Guarding speech and its opposite is tale-bearing. Honoring parents and its opposite is disobedience to parents. Sincerity and its opposite is showing off. Good deeds and their opposite is evil deeds. Modesty and its opposite is display. Prudent concealment and its opposite is broadcasting. Fairness and its opposite is bigotry. Preparedness and its opposite is transgression. Cleanliness and its opposite is filth. Modesty and its opposite is impudence. Moderation and its opposite is aggression. Comfort and its opposite is fatigue. Ease and its opposite is difficulty. Blessing and its opposite is diminishment. Well-being and its opposite is calamity. Moderation in living and its opposite is excess. Wisdom and its opposite is caprice. Dignity and its opposite is levity. Happiness and its opposite is wretchedness. Repentance and its opposite is persistence in sin. Seeking forgiveness and its opposite is self-deception. Vigilance and its opposite is negligence. Supplication and its opposite is disdain. Vitality and its opposite is laziness. Joy and its opposite is sorrow. Familiarity and its opposite is separation. And generosity and its opposite is stinginess.

These traits, all of them from the armies of the intellect, are not gathered together except in a prophet, or a successor of a prophet, or a believer whose heart Allah has tested for faith. As for the rest of our followers, none of them is free from having some of these soldiers [of ignorance] until he completes [his faith] and is purified from the soldiers of ignorance. At that point, he will be in the highest rank with the prophets and the successors. And indeed, that is only attained by knowing the intellect and its soldiers, and by avoiding ignorance and its soldiers. May Allah grant us and you success in His obedience and His pleasure.
ai.seo_question: What are the seventy-five armies of intellect and ignorance according to Imam al-Sadiq in al-Kafi?
ai.summary: This is one of the most celebrated hadiths in al-Kafi, known as the 'Hadith of the Armies of Intellect and Ignorance.' Imam al-Sadiq (AS) was addressing his close followers when the discussion of intellect and ignorance arose. He taught them that Allah created the intellect as the first spiritual creation from His Light, honoring it above all else, while ignorance was created from a dark bitter ocean and was cursed for its arrogance. Each was given seventy-five armies — paired virtues and vices — ranging from faith vs. disbelief to generosity vs. stinginess. The Imam concluded that only Prophets, their successors, or believers tested by Allah possess all seventy-five virtues, while ordinary followers gradually acquire them through self-purification.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Hadeed, from Sama’at Bin Mihran who said, 
‘I was in the presence of Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, and in his<sup>asws</sup> presence was a group of the ones in his<sup>asws</sup> Wilayah, and the mention of the intellect and the ignorance, flowed. So Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Recognise the intellect and its army and the ignorance and its army, and you would be rightly guided’. Sama’at (the narrator) said, ‘So I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘May I be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>! We do not recognise anything except what you<sup>asws</sup> have introduced to us’.

So Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Created the intellect, and it was the first thing Created, from the spiritual (creations), from the right of the Throne, from His<sup>azwj</sup> Light. So He<sup>azwj</sup> Said to it: “Turn around!” So it turned around. Then Said: “Come!” So it came”. So Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Blessed and High Said: “I<sup>azwj</sup> have Created you as a magnificent creation and Honoured you upon the entirety of My<sup>azwj</sup> creation’.

He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Then He<sup>azwj</sup> Created the ignorance from the dark wavy ocean. So He<sup>azwj</sup> Said to it: “Turn around!” So it turned around. Then Said to it: “Come!” But it did not come. So He<sup>azwj</sup> Said to it: “You are being arrogant?” So He<sup>azwj</sup> Cursed it. 
Then He<sup>azwj</sup> Made seventy-five armies for the intellect. So when the ignorance saw what Allah<sup>azwj</sup> had Honoured the intellect with and what He<sup>azwj</sup> had Granted it, (ignorance) harboured the enmity for it. So the ignorance said, ‘O Lord<sup>azwj</sup>! This is a creation like me. You<sup>azwj</sup> Created it, and Honoured it, and Strengthened it, and I am its opposite, and there is not (enough) strength for me in comparison. Therefore, Grant me an army similar to what You<sup>azwj</sup> had Granted it’. So He<sup>azwj</sup> Said: “Yes. But, if you were to disobey Me<sup>azwj</sup> after that, I<sup>azwj</sup> shall Throw you and your army out of My<sup>azwj</sup> Mercy’. It said, ‘I have agreed’. Then He<sup>azwj</sup> Granted it seventy-five armies.

Thus, from what Heazwj Granted to the intellect, from the seventy five armies was the goodness, and it is the Vizier of the intellect; and Made its opposite to be the evil, and it is the Vizier of the ignorance; and the Eman, and its opposite is the disbelief; and the confirmation, and its opposite is the denial; and the hope, and its opposite is the despair; and the justice, and its opposite is the tyranny; and the pleasure, and its opposite is the anger; and the gratefulness, and its opposite is the ingratitude; and the longing, and its opposite is the hopelessness. And the reliance (upon Allahazwj), and its opposite is the independence; and the clemency, and its opposite is the cruelty; and the mercy, and its opposite is the wrath, and the knowledge, and its opposite is the ignorance; and the understanding, and its opposite is the stupidity, and the chastity, and its opposite is the indecency, and ascetism, and its opposite is the desire; and the gentleness, and its opposite is the harshness; and the awe, and its opposite is the audacity; and the humbleness, and its opposite is the arrogance; and the leisureliness, and its opposite is the impulsiveness. And the forbearance, and its opposite is the recklessness; and the silence, and its opposite is the chatter; and the submission, and its opposite is the arrogance; and the acceptance, and its opposite is the doubt; and the patience, and its opposite is the panic; and the pardoning, and its opposite is the revenge; and the richness, and its opposite is the poverty; and the remembrance, and its opposite is the omission; and the memorisation, and its opposite is the forgetfulness; and the sympathising, and its opposite is the severing (relationship); and the contentment, and its opposite is the greed; and the consolation, and its opposite is the commiseration.

And the cordiality, and its opposite is the enmity; and the loyalty, and its opposite is the betrayal; and the obedience, and its opposite is the disobedience; and the yielding, and its opposite is the insolence; and the safety, and its opposite is the affliction; and the love, and its opposite is the hatred; and the truthfulness, and its opposite is the lying; and the truth, and its opposite is the falsehood; and the trustworthiness, and its opposite is the defrauding; and the purity, and its opposite is the adulteration; and the chivalry, and its opposite is the apathy. And the understanding, and its opposite is the foolishness; and the recognition, and its opposite is the denial; and the compliance, and its opposite is the disclosure; and safeguarding the hidden matters, and its opposite is the non-restraint; and the concealment, and its opposite is the disclosure; and the Salāt, and its opposite is the wastage (not praying); and the Fasting, and its opposite is the abandoning (of Fasting); and the Jihad, and its opposite is the abstaining; and the Hajj, and its opposite is renouncing the Covenant. And preservation of the Hadeeth, and its opposite is the gossiping; and righteousness with the parents, and its opposite is the disloyalty; and the reality, and its opposite is the showing-off; and the goodness, and its opposite is the evil; and the covering up, and its opposite is the shameless display; and the dissimulation, and its opposite is the broadcasting; and the fairness, and its opposite is prejudice; and the calmness, and its opposite is the rebellion, and the cleanliness, and its opposite is the filth. And the bashfulness, and its opposite is the indiscreet; and the moderation, and its opposite is the indulgence; and the rest, and its opposite is the exhaustion; and the ease, and its opposite is the difficulty; and the Blessings, and its opposite is the annihilation; and the well-being, and its opposite is the calamity; and the straightness, and its opposite is the crookedness; and the wisdom, and its opposite is the whims; and the dignity, and its opposite is the meanness; and the happiness, and its opposite is the wretchedness. And the repentance, and its opposite is the persistence; and the seeking of Forgiveness, and its opposite is the pride; and the preservation, and its opposite is the complacency; and the supplication, and its opposite is the refraining; and the activity, and its opposite is the laziness; and the joy, and its opposite is the grief, and the friendliness, and its opposite is the aversion; and the generosity, and its opposite is the stinginess.

So all these characteristics from the armies of the intellect would not gather in anyone except a Prophetsaww, or a successoras, or a Momin whose heart Allahazwj has been Tested for the Eman. And as for the rest of that, from the ones in ourasws Wilayah, so one of them would not be empty from some of these armies to be in him until he is perfect and transfers from the armies of the ignorance. Thus, during that, he would happen to be in the lofty levels along with the Prophetsas, and the successorsas, and rather he would achieve that with the recognition of the intellect and its armies, and by keeping aside from the ignorance and its armies. May Allahazwj Harmonise us and you all for Hisazwj obedience, and Hisazwj Pleasure’.
